title: Beyond the 956: $1 million lottery winner arrested by ICE in East Boston days after claiming prize
excerpt: Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales, a native of El Salvador, won $1 million in the Massachusetts Lottery with a $10 scratch-off ticket — and six days later, ICE officers arrested him in East Boston, the same neighborhood where he bought the winning ticket.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Ariel Antonio Velasquez-Morales won $1 million in the Massachusetts Lottery — and six days later, federal immigration officers arrested him in the same East Boston neighborhood where he bought the winning ticket.

Velasquez-Morales, a native of El Salvador, bought a $10 “$2,000,000 50X Cashword” scratch-off at a market in East Boston and matched 11 words, the Massachusetts Lottery said. The lottery awarded him the $1 million prize on November 18, 2026, and posted a photo of him holding an oversized check three days later. He chose the lump-sum cash option: $650,000 before taxes.

On Tuesday morning, November 24, officers with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement arrested him in East Boston. Three ICE sources told Fox News that Velasquez-Morales ran when officers moved in, sparking a brief foot chase before officers caught him. ICE said he had been living in the United States under a final deportation order issued in April 2014, and that he entered the country illegally in 2013 near Roma, Texas.

ICE said Velasquez-Morales remains in custody pending his removal from the United States. “Looks like his luck ran out,” ICE Assistant Director of Public Affairs Micah Bock said in the agency’s announcement of the arrest.

No criminal charges against Velasquez-Morales have been reported in connection with this arrest; published reports describe it as an immigration enforcement action under the 2014 removal order. He is presumed innocent of any criminal allegation unless charged and proven guilty in court.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram; U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement — “Illegal alien lottery winner’s luck runs out with ICE Boston arrest”; CNN — “A man in Boston won $1 million in the lottery. Then ICE arrested him,” Nov. 25, 2026; USA Today; Fox News.
